'''Whitestone City Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Whitestone City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]. The facility contained numerous landing bays and was surrounded by residential districts, some of which were considered rundown and gave the appearance of a slum. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a [[stormtrooper station]] was located near [[Bay thirty-five]] and [[Bay thirty-six|thirty-six]].<ref name="COO" />
